role: Backbone load. Infrastructure substrate. Holds the weight of all systems. 15-45% load always — this is the cost of running 27 God Systems in parallel. Never zero.
tick_behavior: Load: 15-45% constant. Entropy 0.05-0.10. The floor. If ATLAS load exceeds 80%, system enters degraded mode — KRONOS slows tick rate.
constraints: Load never drops to zero while system is running
